g.text: LKT augmented GRU with a 128-unit prediction head
Saved model: augmented__head128__seed1 | restored epoch 24 | 31,585 parameter entries
A Inputs available before response t
log(1 + student time gap in seconds)
Input dropout 0.1 produces x(t), shared by prediction and memory update
Embeddings are trained jointly with the network. The centered intercept coordinate is zero; no problem-text embedding is used.
Current response y(t) does not enter this prediction. No separate inference network or Gaussian latent is present.
C Observe the answer, then update all three GRU layers
Retain all three states for the next trial: [h1(t), h2(t), h3(t)] = 3 × 32 values
Each new participant starts with zero states. Updated memory can affect the NEXT prediction, p(t+1).
Dropout is active only during training. Binary cross-entropy trains the logits; all learned weights stay fixed during continuation.
